We carry a large selection of both progressive and fixed jackpot slots. Progressive jackpots grow with every stake placed across the network. The current prize pool for each game is visible on the slot card before you open it. Every jackpot win credits directly to your main balance with no wagering requirement attached.

Our table game section covers the core casino formats. Each title runs on certified RNG software, independently audited to the same standard as our slot catalogue. The table section include multiple variants of each format, covering different rule sets and bet ranges.

Klarna live dealer section connects players to real tables hosted by certified studios in real time. Tables run around the clock across multiple time zones, with bet limits spanning both casual and high-roller ranges. Available formats include blackjack, roulette, baccarat, and game show titles. All live tables stream in HD with multiple camera angles and full audio.

Crash games work on a different principle to slots - a multiplier climbs from 1x upward and you cash out before it stops. The longer you wait, the higher the potential return, but the round can end at any point. We carry a selection of certified crash titles in a dedicated section of the lobby. The format suits players who prefer short, high-intensity rounds over extended slot sessions.

faq.title: How many new Klarna Casino games appear on the platform each month?
faq.text: We add new titles on a rolling basis throughout each month, typically 5 to 10 games as studios release certified content. New games appear under a dedicated filter in the lobby so you can track additions without searching the full catalogue. The volume varies month to month depending on studio release schedules.

faq.title: Do all games count equally toward bonus wagering requirements?
faq.text: No, game contribution rates toward wagering requirements vary by title and category. Slots typically contribute 100%, while live casino tables and certain other formats contribute at a reduced rate or not at all. Check the bonus terms for the specific offer you are clearing before you choose your game.

faq.title: Can I try Klarna for free before depositing?
faq.text: Most slots in our catalogue support a demo mode accessible without a registered account. Live casino tables and jackpot games do not offer a free play option - these require a real money stake. Use demo mode to test mechanics and volatility before committing your balance.
